title: Item Removal from the Larkspur Valuables Floater Schedule
content:
## Larkspur Valuables Floater conditions: removing an item from the schedule

**(a) When an item is removed.** An item is removed when the named insured has sold or given it away or no longer owns it, or when its total loss has been paid.

**(b) Effective date.** A removal is effective no earlier than the date the named insured requests it, except that it may be backdated to a documented sale or gift date by no more than the tier's removal backdating allowance in calendar days.

**(c) Once only.** An item that has already been removed is never removed again. Whether an item has already been removed is read from the schedule: a removal already recorded against the item's scheduling entry.

## Reasons recorded for a removal

| Reason | Basis |
|---|---|
| Sold | the named insured has sold the item |
| Gifted | the named insured has given it away |
| No longer owned | the named insured no longer owns it |
| Total loss paid | the item's total loss has been paid |

## Reading condition (b)

- The backdating exception reaches only a documented sale or gift date; a removal the named insured requests without one is effective no earlier than the date requested.
- On the Valuables Floater Classic the allowance is 0 days, so a removal there is never backdated.

## Hypothetical cases on a Valuables Floater Select (allowance 30 calendar days)

The named insured requests removal on 20 July.

| Documented sale date | Days before the request | Removal effective |
|---|---|---|
| 25 June | 25 | may be backdated to 25 June |
| 20 June | 30 | may be backdated to 20 June (exactly 30 days) |
| 10 June | 40 | not backdated to 10 June, which is more than 30 days back |
| no documented sale or gift | none | no earlier than 20 July |

A second request to remove a ring whose removal is already on the schedule is not recorded again.
